support_claim: crm:OAK-77 names the pre-rebrand Oakfield Logistics entity, and identity-establishing evidence shows that entity continued as Oakfield Logistik GmbH under unchanged HRB 88421, which is the billed counterparty on the right.

propositions.proposition: Oakfield rebranded in 2023 from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH, and Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change.
propositions.relevance: Documents that the pre-rebrand and post-rebrand legal names refer to one continuing legal entity via an unchanged registry identifier.

propositions.proposition: CRM still shows the old English-facing name for the rebranded Oakfield entity.
propositions.relevance: Links the CRM left referent (old English-facing name) to the same legal counterparty that now bills as Oakfield Logistik GmbH.

propositions.proposition: CRM record OAK-77 is named Oakfield Logistics and is active.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the left referent crm:OAK-77 to the old English-facing name described in the commercial notes.

propositions.proposition: Handelsregister HRB 88421 lists Oakfield Logistik GmbH as an active German company.
propositions.relevance: Confirms the post-rebrand legal name and ties it to the unchanged registry number cited in the rebrand note.

propositions.proposition: Billing records use billed_name Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the right referent billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH to the post-rebrand legal name of the entity described in the commercial notes and registry.
